GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Raced keenly through the early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: was Just a Bit Slow Out then Went Forward Wide out. Kept Coming up to Equal Lead Two Wide 550m. Slight Advantage Straightening Up then hit the wall badly. Gradually Gave Ground to last (vetted - all clear) # wide!/wilted
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rider reported that after initially obtaining a position near midfield, her mount commenced to race keenly and, as a consequence, she shifted the gelding out and allowed it to improve to settle outside the leader near the 600m. She said that her mount continued to race keenly and consequently failed to close its race off. A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat handy 1 length off, eased 3 Wide turn, Straightened Up 1 length off, half off 200m, same 100m, kept finding the line late, took a dive but just missed # had run/good
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Approaching the 1000m had to be eased from heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Away OK. Rolled fwd & raced behind leaders Two Wide (2L from lead) early . Tracked leaders on inside midrace & got inside run (1L from lead) on home turn. Pushed along Two Wide @ 400m & pressured @ 250m. Hit top @ 100m & lifted late but bloused on line. # Every Chance
Jumped Fair bustled, caught 3 Wide 3-4 Lengths off, swung wider turn ridded along, Straightened Up 2 Lengths off, kept on well one pace to the line after tough run # 3 Wide trip
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted out on jumping and bumped another rnr.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Touch slow away. Worked fwd Five Wide until raced 2nd 3 Wide No Cover (1/2L from lead) early . Worked to hold ground midrace & pushed out Five Wide (1L from lead) on home turn. Pushed along @ 300m & pressured @ 250m. Faded in last 150m. # Wide & faded.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Travelled wide and without cover for the majority of the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , showed abundance of speed to lead rails 600m, gave kick and had Clear lead soon after Straightening Up , claimed last 50m and one better but held Clear second spot # overran late
